name: AnimatedPBR3D
description: Attach custom PBR textures (Albedo, Normal, Roughness, Metalness, AO, Emissive) from project image resources to 3D objects, and animate textures with real-time UV scrolling, flipbook/spritesheet frame animation, UV rotation, and video textures.
author: Christopher Monhollen

eventsBasedBehaviors.name: AnimatedPBR3D
eventsBasedBehaviors.description: Controls PBR materials and real-time texture animations (UV scroll, flipbook spritesheet, video) on a 3D object.

properties.name: ApplyOnCreation
properties.label: Apply On Creation
properties.description: Automatically apply the configured material when the 3D renderer is ready.

properties.name: IncludeChildren
properties.label: Include Children
properties.description: Apply material to all child meshes inside the 3D model.

properties.name: TargetMode
properties.label: Target Mode
properties.description: Which materials inside the 3D object to modify.

properties.name: MaterialIndex
properties.label: Material Index
properties.description: Index of the material to target (when Target Mode is 'Material index').

properties.name: MaterialName
properties.label: Material Name
properties.description: Name of the material to target (when Target Mode is 'Material name').

properties.name: MeshName
properties.label: Mesh Name
properties.description: Name of the mesh to target (when Target Mode is 'Mesh name').

properties.name: CloneMaterials
properties.label: Clone Materials
properties.description: Clone materials so modifications do not affect other object instances.

properties.name: AlbedoMap
properties.label: Albedo / Base Color Map
properties.description: Base color texture image from project resources.

properties.name: UseBaseColor
properties.label: Use Base Color Tint
properties.description: Apply a base color tint over the albedo texture.

properties.name: BaseColor
properties.label: Base Color Tint
properties.description: Base color tint (RGB).

properties.name: NormalMap
properties.label: Normal Map
properties.description: Surface normal bump texture image.

properties.name: NormalScale
properties.label: Normal Map Scale
properties.description: Intensity of the normal map bump effect.

properties.name: RoughnessMap
properties.label: Roughness Map
properties.description: Micro-surface roughness texture image.

properties.name: Roughness
properties.label: Roughness Factor (0-1)
properties.description: Overall surface roughness (0.0 = mirror smooth, 1.0 = rough matte).

properties.name: MetalnessMap
properties.label: Metalness Map
properties.description: Metallic reflection mask texture image.

properties.name: Metalness
properties.label: Metalness Factor (0-1)
properties.description: Overall surface metalness (0.0 = dielectric / wood / stone, 1.0 = metal).

properties.name: AOMap
properties.label: Ambient Occlusion (AO) Map
properties.description: Ambient occlusion crevice shadow map image.

properties.name: AOIntensity
properties.label: AO Intensity (0-1)
properties.description: Strength of the ambient occlusion shadow darkening.

properties.name: EmissiveMap
properties.label: Emissive Map
properties.description: Glow / self-illumination mask texture image.

properties.name: EmissiveColor
properties.label: Emissive Color
properties.description: Color of the self-illuminating glow.

properties.name: EmissiveStrength
properties.label: Emissive Strength
properties.description: Intensity of the emissive glow.

properties.name: TextureFiltering
properties.label: Texture Filtering
properties.description: Pixel interpolation filtering mode.

properties.name: TilingX
properties.label: Tiling X (Repeat)
properties.description: Horizontal texture repetition multiplier.

properties.name: TilingY
properties.label: Tiling Y (Repeat)
properties.description: Vertical texture repetition multiplier.

properties.name: OffsetX
properties.label: Offset X
properties.description: Base horizontal UV offset.

properties.name: OffsetY
properties.label: Offset Y
properties.description: Base vertical UV offset.

properties.name: RotationAngle
properties.label: UV Rotation (Degrees)
properties.description: Texture rotation angle in degrees.

properties.name: RotationCenterX
properties.label: Rotation Center X
properties.description: Pivot point X for texture rotation (0.5 = center).

properties.name: RotationCenterY
properties.label: Rotation Center Y
properties.description: Pivot point Y for texture rotation (0.5 = center).

properties.name: EnableScroll
properties.label: Enable UV Scrolling
properties.description: Continuously animate UV offset and rotation every frame (e.g. lava, water, conveyor).

properties.name: ScrollSpeedX
properties.label: Scroll Speed X
properties.description: Horizontal scrolling speed (UV units per second).

properties.name: ScrollSpeedY
properties.label: Scroll Speed Y
properties.description: Vertical scrolling speed (UV units per second).

properties.name: ScrollRotationSpeed
properties.label: Rotation Speed (deg/sec)
properties.description: Texture rotation speed (degrees per second).

properties.name: EnableFlipbook
properties.label: Enable Flipbook Animation
properties.description: Animate the texture across a 2D spritesheet grid of frames (e.g. animated faces, screens).

properties.name: FlipbookColumns
properties.label: Flipbook Columns (X frames)
properties.description: Number of horizontal frames in the spritesheet.

properties.name: FlipbookRows
properties.label: Flipbook Rows (Y frames)
properties.description: Number of vertical frames in the spritesheet.

properties.name: FlipbookFPS
properties.label: Animation FPS
properties.description: Playback frame rate (frames per second).

properties.name: FlipbookLoop
properties.label: Loop Animation
properties.description: Loop the spritesheet animation continuously.

properties.name: FlipbookTotalFrames
properties.label: Total Frames (0 = all)
properties.description: Total frames in animation sequence (0 uses Columns * Rows).

properties.name: AlphaMode
properties.label: Alpha Mode
properties.description: Transparency and alpha blending mode.

properties.name: Alpha
properties.label: Alpha Opacity (0-1)
properties.description: Overall opacity transparency (for Blend mode).

properties.name: AlphaCutoff
properties.label: Alpha Cutoff (Cutout Mode)
properties.description: Alpha threshold for Cutout mode.

properties.name: DepthWrite
properties.label: Depth Write
properties.description: Write to depth buffer (disable for transparent overlays/particles).

properties.name: MaterialSide
properties.label: Material Side
properties.description: Render front faces, back faces, or double sided.

properties.name: Wireframe
properties.label: Wireframe
properties.description: Render polygon mesh wireframe.

properties.name: CastShadow
properties.label: Cast Shadow
properties.description: Object casts shadows from directional/point lights.

properties.name: ReceiveShadow
properties.label: Receive Shadow
properties.description: Object receives shadows cast by other objects.

eventsFunctions.name: SetAlbedoTexture
eventsFunctions.description: Set the albedo base color texture from an image resource.

eventsFunctions.name: SetNormalTexture
eventsFunctions.description: Set the normal bump map texture and scale.

eventsFunctions.name: SetRoughnessTexture
eventsFunctions.description: Set the roughness texture map and factor value (0 to 1).

eventsFunctions.name: SetMetalnessTexture
eventsFunctions.description: Set the metalness texture map and factor value (0 to 1).

eventsFunctions.name: SetEmissiveTexture
eventsFunctions.description: Set the emissive glow texture map, color, and strength.
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set emissive map of _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_ with color _PARAM3_;_PARAM4_;_PARAM5_ (strength: _PARAM6_)

eventsFunctions.name: SetScrollSpeed
eventsFunctions.description: Configure continuous UV texture scrolling speeds and rotation speed.
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set UV scroll speed of _PARAM0_ to X: _PARAM2_, Y: _PARAM3_ (rotation: _PARAM4_ deg/s)

eventsFunctions.name: EnableScrolling
eventsFunctions.description: Turn UV scrolling animation on or off.

eventsFunctions.name: SetTiling
eventsFunctions.description: Set the horizontal and vertical texture repetition factors.
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set texture tiling of _PARAM0_ to X: _PARAM2_, Y: _PARAM3_

eventsFunctions.name: SetFlipbookConfig
eventsFunctions.description: Configure spritesheet columns, rows, FPS, and loop mode.
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set flipbook animation on _PARAM0_ (columns: _PARAM2_, rows: _PARAM3_, FPS: _PARAM4_, loop: _PARAM5_)

eventsFunctions.name: SetFlipbookFrame
eventsFunctions.description: Jump directly to a specific animation frame index (0-based).
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set current flipbook frame of _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_

eventsFunctions.name: PlayFlipbook
eventsFunctions.description: Resume or start playing the flipbook spritesheet animation.

eventsFunctions.name: PauseFlipbook
eventsFunctions.description: Pause the flipbook spritesheet animation on current frame.

eventsFunctions.name: SetVideoTexture
eventsFunctions.description: Load and play an MP4/WebM video file as the 3D surface texture.
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set video texture on _PARAM0_ from URL _PARAM2_ (loop: _PARAM3_, muted: _PARAM4_)

eventsFunctions.name: PlayVideo
eventsFunctions.description: Play or resume video texture playback.

eventsFunctions.name: PauseVideo
eventsFunctions.description: Pause video texture playback.

eventsFunctions.name: IsFlipbookPlaying
eventsFunctions.description: Check if the flipbook spritesheet animation is currently playing.

eventsFunctions.name: IsFlipbookFinished
eventsFunctions.description: Check if the non-looping flipbook animation reached its last frame.

eventsFunctions.name: IsScrollingEnabled
eventsFunctions.description: Check if UV scrolling is currently active.

eventsFunctions.name: IsMaterialReady
eventsFunctions.description: Check if the 3D material has been successfully initialized.

eventsFunctions.name: CurrentFrame
eventsFunctions.description: Get the current active flipbook frame index (0-based).

eventsFunctions.name: TotalFrames
eventsFunctions.description: Get the total number of frames in the active flipbook animation.

eventsFunctions.name: ScrollOffsetX
eventsFunctions.description: Get the current accumulated horizontal UV scroll offset.

eventsFunctions.name: ScrollOffsetY
eventsFunctions.description: Get the current accumulated vertical UV scroll offset.

eventsFunctions.name: ScrollRotation
eventsFunctions.description: Get the current accumulated UV rotation angle in degrees.
